header: What each desk at Northstar takes care of

items.title: Commissioning
items.content: Scopes each issue nine months ahead, invites authors, and keeps the running list of subjects the Quarterly has not covered well enough yet.

items.title: Research operations
items.content: Keeps the roster of 210 referees current, reviews turnaround times every Monday, and steps in whenever a manuscript passes 30 days.

items.title: Rights and archive
items.content: Clears permissions, registers DOIs, and moves every paper into open access in the twelfth month after its issue date.
